sections.text_helper: Section 24.4.9 "OPAMP programmable gain" in chapter 24 (Operational amplifier (OPAMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 736.
sections.section_content:
In PGA mode, OPAMP allows selecting one of discrete positive (noninverting configuration)
or negative (inverting configuration) gain values. The selection is done through the bits [2:0]
of the PGA_GAIN[4:0] bitfield of the OPAMP_CSR register or through the bits [2:0] of the
PGAS_GAIN[4:0] bitfield of the OPAMP_TCMR register. The control bitfield is selected with
the control signal at the output of the opamp_tpX selector.
In noninverting mode, the programmable gain depends only upon the internal resistive
divider. In inverting mode, depends upon the internal resistors, and upon the output
impedance of the signal source. The higher it is, the greater impact it has on the final gain.
